title: Events
summary: Events are disposable telemetry. Attribution uses explicit context project, item project, session project for every event type, then the project token. Query, count, anomalies and tail read all events authorized for the actor unless --project is explicit. Only organization admins can read project-less events. Frontend reads support visitor_id, restricted to frontend envelope matches without broadening organization-admin access to global rows. Browser context adds language, time zone and screen/viewport sizes; the collector stamps trusted client_ip and optional DB-IP location/network fields. GeoIP databases are optional and never gate collection.
